svg.title: GRC Lake — collect, evaluate, resolve, and export
svg.desc: Read-only evidence from 24 implemented sources, including 6 marked preview, deterministic control evaluation through a common control framework, owned findings, and hash-chained, verifiable audit records.

g.text: Read-only evidence → deterministic controls → owned findings → assessment exports.
